```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(lme4)
```

```{r read-data}
data_full <- read_excel("pilot_data/rep_pressure_coding.xlsx")
```

```{r}
filtered_data <- data_full %>%
  filter(
    participant >= 15,
    excluded != 1 | is.na(excluded),
    choice %in% c("book", "other")
    )
```

```{r binary}
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(choice_binary = if_else(choice == "book", 1, 0))
```

```{r}
model <- glmer(choice_binary ~ certainty * condition + (1 | participant_id),
               data = filtered_data,
               family = binomial)
```

```{r}
tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```
```{r}
data_highrep <- filtered_data %>% 
  filter(condition == "high rep pressure")

data_lowrep <- filtered_data %>% 
  filter(condition == "low rep pressure")
```

```{r}
model_high <- glmer(choice_binary ~ certainty + (1 | participant_id),
               data = data_highrep,
               family = binomial)

tidy(model_high, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```

```{r}
model_low <- glmer(choice_binary ~ certainty + (1 | participant_id),
               data = data_lowrep,
               family = binomial)

tidy(model_low, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
```

```{r graph-updated}
summary_data <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(condition, certainty) %>%
  summarise(pct_book = mean(choice_binary) * 100, .groups = "drop")

ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = summary_data,
            aes(x = certainty, y = pct_book, fill = certainty),
            color = "black", width = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = summary_data,
             aes(x = certainty, 
                 y = pct_book, 
                 label = paste0(round(pct_book), "%")),
                vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = filtered_data,
               aes(x = certainty, y = choice_binary * 100, color = choice),
               width = 0.15, height = 2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~condition) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("high" = "#f4b8c1", "low" = "#f7f7c9")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("book" = "#f4b8c1", "other" = "grey40")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-5, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                       labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%")) +
  labs(x = "Certainty", y = "Percentage of Children Chose Book",
        fill = "certainty", color = "choice") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
         strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
         panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
         panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r noelles-analysis}
plot_data <- filtered_data %>%
  count(condition, certainty, choice) %>%
  group_by(condition, certainty) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))


figure <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = certainty,y = percent,fill = choice)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 1)),position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  geom_jitter(data = filtered_data,aes(x = certainty, y = ifelse(choice == "book", 1, 0), color = choice),inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.25, height = 0.03, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(-0.05, 1.05)) +
  labs(x = "Certainty",y = "Percentage of Children",fill = "Choice") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("book" = "pink", "other" = "lavender")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("book" = "pink", "other" = "lavender")) + 
  theme_minimal()

figure
```
